verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents AgentOS, an official toolkit/MCP-style server for AI agents to act on production accounts (reading balances, issuing cards, etc.), plus a separate developer connector for coding agents to access docs/sandbox, and a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at the AgentOS URL. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of AgentOS functioning as a standards-compliant MCP server and details on setup/auth reliability.
